title: A Papyrus deployment needs no hand-made cloud resources
description: Ryan's rule (2026-11-11): nobody creates a cloud resource by hand. Every resource is defined in Git and applied by a pipeline on merge; agents read with the AWS CLI and never create or change. Person-only steps: the one seed apply, registrar name servers, the Google OAuth client, and secret values (CloudFormation cannot create SecureString parameters). Humorus issue: HUM-be87f4 (design draft in its comments). Must not regress the running Anthus deployments: the papyrus-pipeline-approver stack, the AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable and the role-change approval workflow keep working. New pieces are additive: infra/account/ (account baseline and account stack templates), stack_deploy.py with --config, CloudFormation IMPORT, the reusable workflow account-stacks.yml.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Progress 2026-11-11: mechanism merged to develop (PR #1404). First real use on Humorus: the seed update executed (UPDATE_COMPLETE, trust unchanged) after review-only change sets showed Modify/Add and a single Import each for the zone and budget. Findings: (1) an IMPORT change set cannot add Outputs (fixed in #1404); (2) AWS::Budgets::Budget NotificationsWithSubscribers and BudgetName are create-only, so an adopted budget must declare its live subscriber exactly (read from SSM at deploy time); (3) a repository with immutable OIDC subject claims is refused by roles trusting repo:<owner>/<repo> (fix in PR #1405: GithubSubjectPrefix). Anthus imports remain design and dry-run only.
